tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Old English hopian, 'to hope', a Christian virtue name. Its root is Old English hopian. A virtue name from the Christian theological virtue of hope (1 Corinthians 13:13). Hope is a English name meaning “Hope; expectation”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
